Fixed in 5df7bf3. The CRM build failure was caused by `project.view.ts` using numeric columns (`2 as const`) while `@objectstack/spec` expects string literals (`"1" | "2" | "3" | "4"`). Reverted to the original string format. The `ModalForm.tsx` section auto-upgrade already uses `Number()` conversion to handle both formats at runtime.
